about: VJR's dummy content pack and session flow (17 Oct 2026), word for word from the Phase 12 brief, Appendix A. DUMMY DATA for the local site: the facts and riddles are the author's and must be checked before any real session. Purposes are facilitator guidance and are stored nowhere. 'reveal' is a line the pack wants shown after the answer: no list has a column for it (see UX-REVIEW.md). 'descriptionGiven: false' marks an activity whose description the pack left out; the Template's is used and the review lists it.

sessionFlow.purpose: Capture what matters in the client’s own words
Warm up with a quick quiz

activities.title: Straight talk
activities.description: Vote on your top business objectives for transformation

questions.prompt: Which objectives are top of mind for you?

activities.title: Confidence continuum
activities.description: Rate your confidence in Deloitte’s delivery capabilities

questions.prompt: How confident are you that Deloitte has the capabilities to deliver this solution?

activities.title: Open feedback
activities.description: Tell us what would make this partnership a success

questions.prompt: What is the one thing we must get right for this program to succeed in your eyes?
What has held back earlier transformation efforts in your organization?
What would you want to see in the first 90 days to feel confident?
Where do you want us to challenge your thinking?

activities.title: MCQ
activities.description: Quick quiz to warm up the room

questions.prompt: Where was Deloitte founded?
Which delivery approach builds value in small, frequent increments?
Which line is part of Deloitte’s brand platform?

activities.title: Guess the brand
activities.description: Name the brand behind the riddle

questions.prompt: “When work runs long and plans go astray, ______ helps home-cooked meals find their way.”
questions.reveal: “Kroger helps busy households get fresh meals on the table, in store or online.”

activities.title: Straight talk
activities.description: Vote on the business objectives that matter most for Kroger’s next phase of transformation

questions.prompt: Which objectives are top of mind for you?
options: Reduce cost (supply chain and store operations)
Modernize technology (data, cloud, and commerce platforms)
Enhance customer experience (personalization, digital, and in-store)
Scale talent model (associate productivity and skills)

activities.title: Confidence continuum
activities.description: Rate your confidence in Deloitte’s ability to deliver for Kroger

questions.prompt: How confident are you that Deloitte can deliver a solution that works across stores, digital, and supply chain?
Where does the gap between the customer experience you want and what you deliver today show up most?
What would make an associate say, “this change made my shift easier”?
Which past initiative should we learn from, good or bad?

activities.title: MCQ
activities.description: How well do you know Kroger? Play along with the team.

questions.prompt: Where is Kroger headquartered?
Which data science and analytics subsidiary is part of Kroger?
Which of these is Kroger’s private-label natural and organic brand?
“When work runs long and plans go astray, ______ helps home-cooked meals find their way.”
questions.reveal: “Fresh, convenient, and easy for the busy household. That’s the experience we want to help scale.”

activities.title: Straight talk
activities.description: Vote on the business objectives that matter most for Domino’s next phase of growth

questions.prompt: Which objectives are top of mind for you?
options: Reduce cost (store economics and supply chain)
Modernize technology (digital ordering and data platforms)
Enhance customer experience (ordering, tracking, and loyalty)
Scale talent model (franchisee and store team capability)

activities.title: Confidence continuum
activities.description: Rate your confidence in Deloitte’s ability to deliver for Domino’s

questions.prompt: How confident are you that Deloitte can deliver a solution that works for corporate teams and franchisees?
What would a perfect order look like from tap to doorstep, and where does it break today?
What do franchisees need most from a transformation program?
Where would you want us to challenge your current approach?

activities.title: MCQ
activities.description: How well do you know Domino’s? Play along with the team.

questions.prompt: Which feature lets customers follow an order from prep to delivery?
Where is Domino’s headquartered?
What is the name of Domino’s loyalty program?
“When the game runs late and the fridge is bare, ______ brings a hot pizza right to your chair.”
questions.reveal: “Fast, hot, and tracked from tap to doorstep. That’s the order journey we want to help you keep improving.”
